verdict.rationale: Pulumi's Automation API is documented as a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the CLI. It lets developers use the Pulumi engine as an SDK to create, update, configure and destroy infrastructure from their own software (pulumi-docs-2, pulumi-docs-33, pulumi-docs-34, pulumi-gh-4). A hands-on community user confirms using it to code infra migrations instead of bash wrappers (pulumi-comm-2). Missing for 10: no in-pack detail on language coverage of the Automation API or on preview/up operation specifics.
